kaikki_vikisozluk.e: اِجْرَمَزَّ • (ijramazza) IVq (non-past يَجْرَمِزُّ (yajramizzu), verbal noun اِجْرِمْزَاز (ijrimzāz))
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Compare جَرْمَزَ (jarmaza, “to contract, to flee”). Possibly related to جُرْمُوز (jurmūz, “cistern, small house”).
